   118	/-! ## The ground slice of an enlarged local space -/
   119	
   120	/-- The linear map sending a vector `x` of `ℂ^ι` to `x ⊗ |⊥⟩`, where `|⊥⟩` is the
   121	basis vector of the auxiliary register `ℂ^{Option α}` indexed by the adjoined
   122	point.  Formalization-only support for the dilation used by `thm:ms-rigidity`,
   123	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   124	def naimarkEmbeddingMap (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   125	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   126	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) where
   127	  toFun x := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (ι × Option α) ℂ).symm
   128	    (fun p => if p.2 = none then x p.1 else 0)
   129	  map_add' x y := by
   130	    ext p
   131	    by_cases h : p.2 = none <;> simp [h]
   132	  map_smul' c x := by
   133	    ext p
   134	    by_cases h : p.2 = none <;> simp [h]
   135	
   136	/-- The isometric identification of a local Hilbert space `ℂ^ι` with the *ground
   137	slice* `ℂ^ι ⊗ |⊥⟩` of the enlarged space `ℂ^{ι × Option α}`.  This single
   138	embedding serves every question of the dilation supporting `thm:ms-rigidity`,
   139	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   140	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   141	noncomputable def naimarkEmbedding (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   142	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   143	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ (ι × Option α) :=
   144	  LinearMap.isometryOfInner (naimarkEmbeddingMap ι α) <| by
   145	    intro x y
   146	    simp [PiLp.inner_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type, naimarkEmbeddingMap]

   148	/-- The coordinates of the ground embedding: the amplitude is carried to the
   149	auxiliary basis vector `|⊥⟩` and vanishes on the other auxiliary vectors. -/
   150	@[simp]
   151	theorem naimarkEmbedding_apply {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   152	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (p : ι × Option α) :
   153	    naimarkEmbedding ι α x p = if p.2 = none then x p.1 else 0 := rfl
   154	
   155	/-- The compression of an operator on the enlarged space to the ground slice.
   156	Formalization-only support for the dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   157	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   158	def naimarkCompression {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   159	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op (ι × Option α)) : Op ι :=
   160	  M.submatrix (fun i => (i, none)) (fun j => (j, none))
   161	
   162	/-- The entries of the ground-slice compression. -/
   163	@[simp]
   164	theorem naimarkCompression_apply {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   165	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op (ι × Option α)) (i j : ι) :
   166	    naimarkCompression (α := α) M i j = M (i, none) (j, none) := rfl
   167	
   168	/-- The compression of the zero operator to the ground slice vanishes. -/
   169	@[simp]
   170	theorem naimarkCompression_zero {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   171	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   172	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (0 : Op (ι × Option α)) = 0 := by
   173	  ext i j; simp
   174	
   175	/-- The compression to the ground slice is additive. -/
   176	theorem naimarkCompression_add {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   177	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   178	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (M + N) =
   179	      naimarkCompression (α := α) M + naimarkCompression (α := α) N := by
   180	  ext i j; simp
   181	
   182	/-- The compression to the ground slice commutes with finite sums. -/
   183	theorem naimarkCompression_sum {ι α β : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   184	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Fintype β] (M : β → Op (ι × Option α)) :
   185	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (∑ b, M b) = ∑ b, naimarkCompression (α := α) (M b) := by
   186	  ext i j; simp [Matrix.sum_apply]
   187	
   188	/-- The compression of the identity to the ground slice is the identity. -/
   189	@[simp]
   190	theorem naimarkCompression_one {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   191	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] :
   192	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (1 : Op (ι × Option α)) = 1 := by
   193	  ext i j
   194	  by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [Matrix.one_apply, h]
   195	
   196	/-- The operator on the enlarged space that acts as `M` on the ground slice and
   197	annihilates its orthogonal complement.  Formalization-only support for the
   198	dilation of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   199	def naimarkInflation {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   200	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) : Op (ι × Option α) :=
   201	  Matrix.of fun p q => if p.2 = none ∧ q.2 = none then M p.1 q.1 else 0
   202	
   203	/-- The entries of the inflation of an operator to the enlarged space. -/
   204	@[simp]
   205	theorem naimarkInflation_apply {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   206	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) (p q : ι × Option α) :
   207	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M p q =

   211	the original operator. -/
   212	@[simp]
   213	theorem naimarkCompression_naimarkInflation {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   214	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   215	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (naimarkInflation (α := α) M) = M := by

   219	theorem naimarkCompression_sub {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   220	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   221	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (M - N) =
   222	      naimarkCompression (α := α) M - naimarkCompression (α := α) N := by
   223	  ext i j; simp

   225	/-! ## The dilated projective measurement -/
   226	
   227	/-- A one-measurement Naimark dilation of a positive operator valued measure,
   228	chosen once and for all.  It provides orthogonal projections on the enlarged
   229	space `ℂ^{d × Option α}` whose ground-slice compressions are the given effects;
   230	see `references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:121-159`. -/
   231	noncomputable def naimarkData {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   232	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) : OneMeasNaimarkData α d :=
   233	  Classical.choose (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement)
   234	
   235	/-- The chosen dilation dilates the intended measurement. -/
   236	theorem naimarkData_source {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   237	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) :
   238	    (naimarkData M).source = M.toSubmeasurement :=
   239	  Classical.choose_spec (oneMeasNaimark M.toSubmeasurement)
   240	
   241	/-- The dilated projections indexed by genuine answers already sum to at most the
   242	identity, since the projection attached to the adjoined point is positive
   243	semidefinite. -/
   244	theorem naimarkData_sum_some_le_one {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   245	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) :
   246	    ∑ a : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) ≤ 1 := by
   247	  have hsplit : ∑ oa : Option α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect oa =
   248	      (naimarkData M).liftedEffect none +
   249	        ∑ a : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) :=
   250	    Fintype.sum_option (f := fun oa => (naimarkData M).liftedEffect oa)
   251	  have hle := (naimarkData M).lifted_sum_le_one
   252	  rw [hsplit] at hle
   253	  have hnone : (0 : Op (d × Option α)) ≤ (naimarkData M).liftedEffect none :=
   254	    (naimarkData M).lifted_pos none
   255	  exact le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hnone) hle
   256	
   257	/-- The sum of the dilated projections indexed by genuine answers is itself an
   258	orthogonal projection. -/
   259	theorem naimarkData_isProj_sum_some {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   260	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) :
   261	    IsProj (∑ a : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a)) :=
   262	  isProj_sum_of_isProj_of_sum_le_one
   263	    (fun a => (naimarkData M).lifted_isProj (some a))
   264	    (naimarkData_sum_some_le_one M)
   265	
   266	/-- The effects of the dilated measurement.  The projection attached to the
   267	answer `a` is the Naimark projection of `a`, except that the distinguished answer
   268	`a₀` also absorbs the deficiency `1 - ∑_a P_a`, which makes the family complete.
   269	Formalization-only construction supporting `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   270	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   271	noncomputable def naimarkDilatedEffect {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   272	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   273	    Op (d × Option α) :=
   274	  (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some a) +
   275	    (if a = a₀ then 1 - ∑ b : α, (naimarkData M).liftedEffect (some b) else 0)
   276	
   277	/-- The dilated effects are positive semidefinite. -/
   278	theorem naimarkDilatedEffect_pos {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   279	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   280	    0 ≤ naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a := by
   281	  unfold naimarkDilatedEffect
   282	  refine add_nonneg ((naimarkData M).lifted_pos (some a)) ?_
   283	  by_cases h : a = a₀
   284	  · simpa [h] using sub_nonneg.mpr (naimarkData_sum_some_le_one M)
   285	  · simp [h]
   286	
   287	/-- The dilated effects sum to the identity. -/
   288	theorem naimarkDilatedEffect_sum {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   289	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ : α) :
   290	    ∑ a : α, naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a = 1 := by
   291	  unfold naimarkDilatedEffect
   292	  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ a₀]
   293	  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_pos]
   294	  abel
   295	
   296	/-- Every dilated effect is an orthogonal projection. -/
   297	theorem naimarkDilatedEffect_isProj {α d : Type} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   298	    [Fintype d] [DecidableEq d] (M : MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement α d) (a₀ a : α) :
   299	    IsProj (naimarkDilatedEffect M a₀ a) := by

     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/

    58	theorem sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    59	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    60	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    61	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    62	      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
    63	  classical
    64	  have hterm : ∀ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    65	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    66	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    67	      ∑ a : msGame.AnswerA, ∑ c : msGame.AnswerB,

   133	/-! ## The dilated effects on the enlarged ground spaces -/
   134	
   135	/-- Alice's dilated postprocessed effect, typed on the enlarged local space
   136	`ℂ^{ιA × Option MsAnswer}`.  Formalization-only abbreviation. -/
   137	abbrev dilatedEffectA (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) (f : MsAnswer → ZMod 2)

   139	  (((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).postprocess f).effect b

   147	/-- Alice's dilated variable bit approximately intertwines with Bob's dilated
   148	constraint bit: the summed squared defect is at most twice the reverse
   149	cell-mismatch mass of the original strategy.  This is the first item of
   150	`fact:agreement` (blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:245-254`) applied to the
   151	dilated strategy, whose Born masses are those of the original one. -/
   152	theorem sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
   153	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, ‖applyOperatorToState
   154	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
   155	          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))
   156	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
   157	  set S' := msDilatedStrategy S
   158	  set PA := (S'.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero
   159	  set QB := (S'.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)
   160	  have h1 := point_distance_le_two_defect (leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S'.ιB) PA)
   161	    (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB) S'.ψ
   162	  rw [point_defect_eq] at h1
   163	  have hnorm : ‖S'.ψ‖ = 1 := S'.ψ_norm
   164	  have hover : ∑ a : ZMod 2, stateQForm S'.ψ
   165	      ((leftPlacedMeasurement (ιB := S'.ιB) PA).effect a *
   166	        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB).effect a) =
   167	      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
   168	    rw [← ms_dilated_strategy_reverse_cell_mismatch_mass S i k,
   169	      ← sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq S' i k]
   170	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
   171	    change stateQForm S'.ψ (heteroKron (PA.effect a) 1 * heteroKron 1 (QB.effect a)) =
   172	      stateQForm S'.ψ (heteroKron (PA.effect a) (QB.effect a))
   173	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul]
   174	  rw [hnorm, hover] at h1
   175	  have h2 : ∑ b : ZMod 2, ‖applyOperatorToState
   176	      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
   177	        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))
   178	      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
   179	      2 * (1 ^ 2 - (1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k)) := h1
   180	  linarith

   267	/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a left-placed dilated operator
   268	and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
   269	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   270	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   271	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) :
   272	    applyOperatorToState
   273	        (heteroKron (P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   274	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   275	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   276	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   277	  have hsplit : P - groundProjection ιA α * P * groundProjection ιA α =
   278	      (1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P +
   279	        (groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α) := by
   280	    noncomm_ring
   281	  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_left, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   282	  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
   283	      (heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α)) 1)
   284	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   285	    rw [show heteroKron ((groundProjection ιA α * P) * (1 - groundProjection ιA α))
   286	        (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =
   287	        heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α * P) 1 * heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1 by
   288	      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
   289	    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,
   290	      applyOperatorToState_zero]
   291	  rw [hzero, add_zero]

   293	/-- On the dilated state, the difference between a right-placed dilated operator
   294	and its ground compression is its leakage out of the ground slice. -/
   295	theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_sub_compression (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   296	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   297	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   298	    applyOperatorToState
   299	        (heteroKron 1 (Q - groundProjection ιB α * Q * groundProjection ιB α))
   300	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   301	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
   302	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   303	  have hsplit : Q - groundProjection ιB α * Q * groundProjection ιB α =
   304	      (1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q +
   305	        (groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α) := by
   306	    noncomm_ring
   307	  rw [hsplit, heteroKron_add_right, applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   308	  have hzero : applyOperatorToState
   309	      (heteroKron 1 ((groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α)))
   310	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by
   311	    rw [show heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
   312	        ((groundProjection ιB α * Q) * (1 - groundProjection ιB α)) =
   313	        heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α * Q) * heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α) by
   314	      rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.mul_one]]
   315	    rw [applyOperatorToState_mul, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection,

   321	/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
   322	the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
   323	`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
   324	intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
   325	the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
   326	state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   327	theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   328	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   329	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   330	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   331	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
   332	    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
   333	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   334	        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
   335	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
   336	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   337	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   338	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   339	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   340	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]

   619	/-! ## Composition of the dilation with later local isometries -/
   620	
   621	/-- The matrix of a linear isometry of Euclidean spaces in the computational
   622	bases.  Formalization-only support for `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   623	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   624	noncomputable def isometryMatrix {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   625	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   626	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') : Matrix ι' ι ℂ :=
   627	  Matrix.toEuclideanLin.symm φ.toLinearMap
   628	
   629	/-- Conjugation by an isometry is conjugation by its matrix. -/
   630	theorem conjIsometry_eq {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   631	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   632	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') (M : Op ι) :
   633	    conjIsometry φ M = isometryMatrix φ * M * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := rfl
   634	
   635	/-- The matrix of an isometry acts on vectors as the isometry does. -/
   636	theorem isometryMatrix_mulVec {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   637	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   638	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') (x : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   639	    isometryMatrix φ *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x = WithLp.ofLp (φ x) := by
   640	  have h : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) = φ.toLinearMap :=
   641	    Matrix.toEuclideanLin.apply_symm_apply φ.toLinearMap
   642	  have h' : Matrix.toEuclideanLin (isometryMatrix φ) x = φ x := by rw [h]; rfl
   643	  simpa using congrArg WithLp.ofLp h'
   644	
   645	/-- The columns of the matrix of an isometry are the images of the basis
   646	vectors. -/
   647	theorem isometryMatrix_apply {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   648	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   649	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') (k : ι') (i : ι) :
   650	    isometryMatrix φ k i =
   651	      φ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1)) k := by
   652	  have h := congrFun (isometryMatrix_mulVec φ
   653	    ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1))) k
   654	  rw [← h]
   655	  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.equiv, eq_comm]
   656	
   657	/-- The matrix of a composite isometry is the product of the two matrices. -/
   658	theorem isometryMatrix_comp {ι κ ν : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   659	    [Fintype κ] [DecidableEq κ] [Fintype ν] [DecidableEq ν]
   660	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ κ →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ν)
   661	    (E : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κ) :
   662	    isometryMatrix (φ.comp E) = isometryMatrix φ * isometryMatrix E := by
   663	  ext k i
   664	  have h := congrFun (isometryMatrix_mulVec φ
   665	    (E ((EuclideanSpace.equiv ι ℂ).symm (Pi.single i 1)))) k
   666	  rw [isometryMatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
   667	  simp only [isometryMatrix_apply E]
   668	  simpa [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct] using h.symm
   669	
   670	/-- Conjugating by a composite isometry is conjugating twice.  This is how the
   671	ground embeddings of the dilation combine with the local isometries produced by
   672	the self-testing argument of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint
   673	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   674	theorem conjIsometry_comp {ι κ ν : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

   371	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   372	noncomputable def naimarkDilatedState (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   373	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   374	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   375	    EuclideanSpace ℂ ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   376	  isometryTensor (naimarkEmbedding ιA α) (naimarkEmbedding ιB α) ψ
   377	
   378	/-- The coordinates of the dilated state: the original amplitudes sit on the
   379	ground slice, where both auxiliary registers carry the adjoined basis vector,
   380	and all remaining coordinates vanish. -/
   381	theorem naimarkDilatedState_apply (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   382	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   383	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (p : (ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :
   384	    naimarkDilatedState α ψ p =
   385	      if p.1.2 = none ∧ p.2.2 = none then ψ (p.1.1, p.2.1) else 0 := by
   386	  classical
   387	  obtain ⟨⟨i, oa⟩, ⟨j, ob⟩⟩ := p
   388	  simp only [naimarkDilatedState, isometryTensor]
   389	  by_cases hoa : oa = none
   390	  · by_cases hob : ob = none
   391	    · simp [hoa, hob, EuclideanSpace.equiv, eq_comm]
   392	    · simp [hob]
   393	  · simp [hoa]
   394	
   395	/-- The quadratic form of an operator on a pure state, written out in the
   396	computational basis.  Formalization-only support for the dilation of
   397	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   398	theorem inner_applyOperatorToState {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   399	    (K : Op ι) (u : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) :
   400	    inner ℂ u (applyOperatorToState K u) =
   401	      ∑ p : ι, ∑ q : ι, (starRingEnd ℂ) (u p) * (K p q * u q) := by
   402	  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, applyOperatorToState,
   403	    Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm]
   404	
   405	/-- On the ground slice the dilated state factors as the original amplitude
   406	times the two indicator amplitudes of the auxiliary registers. -/
   407	theorem naimarkDilatedState_apply_mul (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   408	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   409	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) (i : ιA) (oa : Option α) (j : ιB) (ob : Option α) :
   410	    naimarkDilatedState α ψ ((i, oa), (j, ob)) =
   411	      (if oa = none then (1 : ℂ) else 0) *
   412	        ((if ob = none then (1 : ℂ) else 0) * ψ (i, j)) := by
   413	  rw [naimarkDilatedState_apply]
   414	  by_cases h1 : oa = none <;> by_cases h2 : ob = none <;> simp [h1, h2]
   415	
   416	/-- The quadratic form of a product operator on the dilated state agrees with the
   417	quadratic form of the two ground-slice compressions on the original state.  This
   418	is the identity that makes the dilation invisible to every observable quantity of
   419	the strategy. -/
   420	theorem inner_heteroKron_naimarkDilatedState (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   421	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   422	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   423	    (M : Op (ιA × Option α)) (N : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   424	    inner ℂ (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)
   425	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron M N) (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)) =
   426	      inner ℂ ψ (applyOperatorToState
   427	        (heteroKron (naimarkCompression M) (naimarkCompression N)) ψ) := by
   428	  classical
   429	  rw [inner_applyOperatorToState, inner_applyOperatorToState]
   430	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option, naimarkDilatedState_apply_mul,
   431	    heteroKron, Matrix.kroneckerMap_apply, mul_comm, mul_assoc]
   432	
   433	/-- The ground embeddings are isometric, so the dilated state is again a unit
   434	vector when the original one is. -/
   435	theorem naimarkDilatedState_norm (α : Type) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α]
   436	    {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB] [DecidableEq ιB]
   437	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   438	    ‖naimarkDilatedState α ψ‖ = ‖ψ‖ := by
   439	  classical
   440	  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
   441	  congr 1
   442	  simp [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option, naimarkDilatedState_apply_mul]
   443	
   444	/-! ## The dilated Magic Square strategy -/
   445	
   446	/-- The projective dilation of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy.  Both local
   447	spaces acquire one auxiliary register indexed by `Option MsAnswer`, the state is
   448	carried to the ground slice, and each question measurement is replaced by its
   449	Naimark dilation, the deficiency being absorbed by the answer `bit 0`.  This is
   450	the projective strategy on which the self-testing argument of `thm:ms-rigidity`
   451	operates; blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`, paper
   452	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/
   453	noncomputable def msDilatedStrategy (S : Strategy msGame) : Strategy msGame where
   454	  ιA := S.ιA × Option MsAnswer
   455	  ιB := S.ιB × Option MsAnswer
   456	  ψ := naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ
   457	  ψ_norm := by
   458	    show ‖naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ‖ = 1
   459	    rw [naimarkDilatedState_norm]
   460	    exact S.ψ_norm
   461	  A x := naimarkDilatedMeasurement (α := MsAnswer) (S.A x) (MsAnswer.bit 0)
   462	  B y := naimarkDilatedMeasurement (α := MsAnswer) (S.B y) (MsAnswer.bit 0)
   463	
   464	/-- The state of the dilated strategy is the image of the original state under
   465	the two ground embeddings. -/
   466	@[simp]
   467	theorem msDilatedStrategy_psi (S : Strategy msGame) :
   468	    (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ = naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ := rfl
   469	
   470	/-- Alice's dilated question measurements are the Naimark dilations of her
   471	original ones. -/
   472	@[simp]
   473	theorem msDilatedStrategy_A_effect (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) (a : MsAnswer) :
   474	    ((msDilatedStrategy S).A x).effect a =
   475	      naimarkDilatedEffect (α := MsAnswer) (S.A x) (MsAnswer.bit 0) a := rfl
   476	
   477	/-- Bob's dilated question measurements are the Naimark dilations of his
   478	original ones. -/
   479	@[simp]
   480	theorem msDilatedStrategy_B_effect (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType) (b : MsAnswer) :
   481	    ((msDilatedStrategy S).B y).effect b =
   482	      naimarkDilatedEffect (α := MsAnswer) (S.B y) (MsAnswer.bit 0) b := rfl
   483	
   484	/-- Every question measurement of the dilated strategy is projective, which is
   485	the hypothesis under which the Coladangelo--Stark self-test is stated. -/
   486	theorem msDilatedStrategy_isProjective_A (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType) :
   487	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective ((msDilatedStrategy S).A x) :=
   488	  naimarkDilatedMeasurement_isProjective (α := MsAnswer) (S.A x) (MsAnswer.bit 0)
   489	
   490	/-- Every question measurement of the dilated strategy is projective on Bob's
   491	side as well. -/
   492	theorem msDilatedStrategy_isProjective_B (S : Strategy msGame) (y : MsType) :
   493	    MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective ((msDilatedStrategy S).B y) :=
   494	  naimarkDilatedMeasurement_isProjective (α := MsAnswer) (S.B y) (MsAnswer.bit 0)
   495	
   496	/-! ## Preservation of the value-to-parity layer -/
   497	
   498	/-- The dilation preserves every conditioned Born mass. -/
   499	theorem ms_dilated_strategy_outcome_weight (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType)
   500	    (a b : MsAnswer) :
   501	    outcomeWeight (msDilatedStrategy S) x y a b = outcomeWeight S x y a b := by
   502	  show (inner ℂ (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)
   503	      (applyOperatorToState
   504	        (heteroKron (naimarkDilatedEffect (α := MsAnswer) (S.A x) (MsAnswer.bit 0) a)
   505	          (naimarkDilatedEffect (α := MsAnswer) (S.B y) (MsAnswer.bit 0) b))
   506	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ))).re =
   507	    (inner ℂ S.ψ (applyOperatorToState
   508	      (heteroKron ((S.A x).effect a) ((S.B y).effect b)) S.ψ)).re
   509	  rw [inner_heteroKron_naimarkDilatedState, naimarkCompression_naimarkDilatedEffect,
   510	    naimarkCompression_naimarkDilatedEffect]
   511	
   512	/-- The dilation preserves Alice's marginal Born masses. -/
   513	theorem ms_dilated_strategy_alice_outcome_weight (S : Strategy msGame) (x : MsType)
   514	    (a : MsAnswer) :
   515	    aliceOutcomeWeight (msDilatedStrategy S) x a = aliceOutcomeWeight S x a := by
   516	  rw [← sum_outcome_weight_right (msDilatedStrategy S) x x a,
   517	    ← sum_outcome_weight_right S x x a]
   518	  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ms_dilated_strategy_outcome_weight S x x a b

     4	/-!
     5	# Magic Square value-to-parity relations
     6	
     7	This file extracts the elementary probability relations used at the start of
     8	the Magic Square rigidity argument.  A strategy of value at least `1 - ε` has
     9	total rejection mass at most `ε`.  Since the question distribution is
    10	supported on at most 36 directed incidences, the rejection mass at each
    11	incidence is at most `36 * ε`.  This controls malformed answers, consistency
    12	of the two reported bits at every cell, and the parity product on each of the
    13	six row or column constraints.
    14	
    15	The arguments apply to arbitrary finite POVMs.  In particular, malformed
    16	answers remain in the event masses when `msBitOrZero` and
    17	`constraintBitOrZero` turn the common answer alphabet into binary outcomes.
    18	
    19	## References
    20	
    21	The Magic Square game is defined in
    22	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:512-610`
    23	and `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:201-222`.  These relations are the
    24	probabilistic input to the rigidity result cited at paper lines 612-652 from
    25	Coladangelo--Stark, Theorem 6.9.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	open scoped BigOperators Matrix MatrixOrder ComplexOrder
    29	
    30	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT.MagicSquareRigidity
    31	
    32	open MIPStarRE.LDT MIPStarRE.Quantum
    33	
    34	noncomputable section
    35	
    36	/-! ## The directed incidence distribution -/
    37	
    38	/-- The 36 possible directed constraint-variable incidences. -/
    39	def directedIncidence : ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool) → MsType × MsType
    40	  | ((i, k), false) => (.constraint i, .var (msConstraintVars i k))
    41	  | ((i, k), true) => (.var (msConstraintVars i k), .constraint i)
    42	
    43	/-- Every question pair in the Magic Square distribution is a directed incidence. -/
    44	theorem ms_support_subset_directed_incidences :
    45	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support ⊆
    46	      (Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).image directedIncidence := by
    47	  intro xy hxy
    48	  have hedge : Sym2.mk xy.1 xy.2 ∈ msEdges :=
    49	    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hxy).2
    50	  rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hedge with ⟨ik, _hik, heq⟩
    51	  have heq' :
    52	      ((.constraint ik.1, .var (msConstraintVars ik.1 ik.2)) : MsType × MsType) = xy ∨
    53	        ((.constraint ik.1, .var (msConstraintVars ik.1 ik.2)) : MsType × MsType) =
    54	          xy.swap :=
    55	    (Sym2.mk_eq_mk_iff (α := MsType)).mp heq
    56	  rcases heq' with heq' | heq'
    57	  · refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(ik, false), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    58	    simpa [directedIncidence] using heq'
    59	  · refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(ik, true), Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    60	    simpa [directedIncidence] using congrArg Prod.swap heq'
    61	
    62	/-- The Magic Square question distribution has at most 36 support points. -/
    63	theorem ms_support_card_le :
    64	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card ≤ 36 := by
    65	  calc
    66	    (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card ≤
    67	        ((Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).image
    68	          directedIncidence).card :=
    69	      Finset.card_le_card ms_support_subset_directed_incidences
    70	    _ ≤ (Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 6 × Fin 3) × Bool)).card :=
    71	      Finset.card_image_le
    72	    _ = 36 := by norm_num
    73	
    74	/-- A constraint-to-variable incidence belongs to the question support. -/
    75	theorem ms_forward_incidence_mem_support (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    76	    (.constraint i, .var (msConstraintVars i k)) ∈
    77	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support := by
    78	  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    79	  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    80	  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i, k), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    81	
    82	/-- A variable-to-constraint incidence belongs to the question support. -/
    83	theorem ms_reverse_incidence_mem_support (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    84	    (.var (msConstraintVars i k), .constraint i) ∈
    85	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support := by
    86	  apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    87	  refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    88	  rw [Sym2.eq_swap]
    89	  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(i, k), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
    90	
    91	/-- Every supported question pair has probability at least `1 / 36`. -/
    92	theorem ms_question_weight_ge {xy : MsType × MsType}
    93	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
    94	    (1 : ℝ) / 36 ≤ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy := by
    95	  have hmemFilter :
    96	      xy ∈ ((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
    97	        Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges) := hxy
    98	  rw [show (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy =
    99	      1 / ((graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support.card : ℝ) by
   100	    change (Distribution.uniformOnFinset
   101	        ((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
   102	          Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges)).weight xy =
   103	      1 / (((Finset.univ : Finset (MsType × MsType)).filter fun ab =>
   104	        Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ msEdges).card : ℝ)
   105	    rw [Distribution.uniformOnFinset_weight, if_pos hmemFilter]]
   106	  apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le
   107	  · exact_mod_cast Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨xy, hxy⟩
   108	  · exact_mod_cast ms_support_card_le

   110	/-! ## Rejection mass from the game value -/
   111	
   112	/-- The rejection mass conditioned on a question pair. -/
   113	noncomputable def rejectionMass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) : ℝ :=
   114	  outcomeEventWeight S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = false
   115	
   116	/-- The acceptance mass conditioned on a question pair. -/
   117	noncomputable def acceptanceMass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) : ℝ :=
   118	  outcomeEventWeight S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = true
   119	
   120	/-- The rejection mass averaged over the Magic Square question distribution. -/
   121	noncomputable def totalRejectionMass (S : Strategy msGame) : ℝ :=
   122	  avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) fun xy =>
   123	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2
   124	
   125	/-- Acceptance and rejection partition the conditioned answer mass. -/
   126	theorem acceptance_mass_add_rejection_mass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) :
   127	    acceptanceMass S x y + rejectionMass S x y = 1 := by
   128	  rw [← show (∑ a : MsAnswer, ∑ b : MsAnswer, outcomeWeight S x y a b) = 1 by
   129	    exact outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S x y]
   130	  unfold acceptanceMass rejectionMass outcomeEventWeight
   131	  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   132	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   133	  intro a _
   134	  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
   135	  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   136	  intro b _
   137	  cases h : msWinPredicate x y a b <;> simp [h]
   138	
   139	/-- The strategy value is the average conditioned acceptance mass. -/
   140	theorem strategy_value_eq_acceptance_mass (S : Strategy msGame) :
   141	    S.value = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) fun xy =>
   142	      acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2 := by
   143	  rfl
   144	
   145	/-- Total rejection mass is exactly one minus the strategy value. -/
   146	theorem total_rejection_mass_eq_one_sub_value (S : Strategy msGame) :
   147	    totalRejectionMass S = 1 - S.value := by
   148	  rw [show S.value = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   149	      acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) by rfl]
   150	  unfold totalRejectionMass
   151	  calc
   152	    avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   153	        rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2) =
   154	        avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   155	          1 - acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := by
   156	      apply avgOver_congr
   157	      intro xy
   158	      linarith [show acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2 + rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 = 1 by
   159	        exact acceptance_mass_add_rejection_mass S xy.1 xy.2]
   160	    _ = avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun _ => 1) -
   161	        avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   162	          acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := avgOver_sub _ _ _
   163	    _ = 1 - avgOver (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty) (fun xy =>
   164	        acceptanceMass S xy.1 xy.2) := by
   165	      rw [avgOver_const_of_isProbability _ (by
   166	        unfold graphDistribution
   167	        apply Distribution.uniformOnFinset_isProbability
   168	        refine ⟨(.constraint 0, .var (msConstraintVars 0 0)), ?_⟩
   169	        simp [msEdges])]
   170	
   171	/-- Total rejection mass is nonnegative. -/
   172	theorem total_rejection_mass_nonneg (S : Strategy msGame) :
   173	    0 ≤ totalRejectionMass S := by
   174	  unfold totalRejectionMass
   175	  exact avgOver_nonneg _ _ fun xy => outcome_event_weight_nonneg S xy.1 xy.2 _
   176	
   177	/-- Value at least `1 - ε` implies total rejection mass at most `ε`. -/
   178	theorem total_rejection_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   179	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) : totalRejectionMass S ≤ ε := by
   180	  rw [total_rejection_mass_eq_one_sub_value]
   181	  linarith
   182	
   183	/-- Conditioned rejection mass is nonnegative. -/
   184	theorem rejection_mass_nonneg (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType) :
   185	    0 ≤ rejectionMass S x y :=
   186	  outcome_event_weight_nonneg S x y fun a b => msWinPredicate x y a b = false
   187	
   188	/-- A supported conditioned rejection mass is at most 36 times total rejection. -/
   189	theorem rejection_mass_le_thirty_six_mul_total (S : Strategy msGame)
   190	    {xy : MsType × MsType}
   191	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
   192	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * totalRejectionMass S := by
   193	  have hrejection : 0 ≤ rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 :=
   194	    rejection_mass_nonneg S xy.1 xy.2
   195	  have hweight := ms_question_weight_ge hxy
   196	  have hterm :
   197	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy *
   198	          rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ totalRejectionMass S := by
   199	    unfold totalRejectionMass avgOver
   200	    exact Finset.single_le_sum
   201	      (fun z _ => mul_nonneg
   202	        ((graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).nonnegative z)
   203	        (rejection_mass_nonneg S z.1 z.2)) hxy
   204	  have hscaled : (1 / 36 : ℝ) * rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤
   205	      (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).weight xy *
   206	        rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 :=
   207	    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hweight hrejection
   208	  nlinarith
   209	
   210	/-- A supported conditioned rejection mass is at most `36 * ε`. -/
   211	theorem rejection_mass_le (S : Strategy msGame) (ε : ℝ)
   212	    (hwin : 1 - ε ≤ S.value) {xy : MsType × MsType}
   213	    (hxy : xy ∈ (graphDistribution msEdges msEdges_nonempty).support) :
   214	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * ε := by
   215	  calc
   216	    rejectionMass S xy.1 xy.2 ≤ 36 * totalRejectionMass S :=
   217	      rejection_mass_le_thirty_six_mul_total S hxy
   218	    _ ≤ 36 * ε :=
   219	      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (total_rejection_mass_le S ε hwin) (by norm_num)
   220	
   221	/-- An event which always rejects has mass at most the conditioned rejection mass. -/
   222	theorem outcome_event_weight_le_rejection_mass (S : Strategy msGame) (x y : MsType)
   223	    (E : MsAnswer → MsAnswer → Prop) [DecidableRel E]
   224	    (hE : ∀ a b, E a b → msWinPredicate x y a b = false) :
   225	    outcomeEventWeight S x y E ≤ rejectionMass S x y := by
   226	  exact outcome_event_weight_mono S x y E _ hE

   229	
   230	/-- The selected constraint bit, with a wrong-form single-bit answer folded to zero. -/
   231	def constraintBitOrZero (k : Fin 3) : MsAnswer → ZMod 2
   232	  | .triple β => β k
   233	  | .bit _ => 0
   234	
   235	/-- Whether an answer has the wrong form for a variable question. -/
   236	def wrongVariableAnswer : MsAnswer → Bool
   237	  | .triple _ => true
   238	  | .bit _ => false
   239	
   240	/-- Whether an answer has the wrong form for a constraint question. -/
   241	def wrongConstraintAnswer : MsAnswer → Bool
   242	  | .triple _ => false
   243	  | .bit _ => true
   244	
   245	/-- The three cells in any fixed row or column are distinct. -/
   246	theorem constraint_vars_injective (i : Fin 6) : Function.Injective (msConstraintVars i) := by
   247	  intro k l hkl
   248	  apply Fin.ext
   249	  unfold msConstraintVars at hkl

   256	  let k : Fin 3 := ⟨j.val % 3, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
   257	  refine ⟨i, k, ?_⟩
   258	  apply Fin.ext
   259	  simp only [msConstraintVars, i, k]
   260	  rw [if_pos (by omega)]
   261	  omega

    24	/--

   197	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   198	    (μ : Distribution X) (A B : X → Measurement α ι)
   199	    (eval : Γ → X → α) (S : X → Γ → Op ι)
   200	    (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι) (δ : ℝ)
   201	    (hS : ∀ x, (1 - ∑ g : Γ, (S x g)ᴴ * S x g).PosSemidef)

   203	      (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ ≤ δ) :

   206	  have hS' (x : X) : ∑ g : Γ, (S x g)ᴴ * S x g ≤ 1 :=
   207	    Matrix.le_iff.mpr (hS x)
   208	  calc
   209	    opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x g => S x g * (A x).effect (eval g x))
   210	        (fun x g => S x g * (B x).effect (eval g x)) ψ ≤
   211	      opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a)
   212	        (fun x a => (B x).effect a) ψ := by
   213	      unfold opFamilyDistSq
   214	      apply avgOver_mono
   215	      intro x
   216	      simpa only [mul_sub] using
   217	        sum_norm_mul_funIndexed_apply_le (fun g => eval g x) (S x)

   224	theorem opDistSq_sum_sub_mul_le_of_projective {X α ι : Type*}
   225	    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype α]
   226	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   227	    (μ : Distribution X) (A : X → Measurement α ι) (B : X → α → Op ι)

   229	    (hA : ∀ x, MIPStarRE.QPBT.Measurement.IsProjective (A x))
   230	    (h : opFamilyDistSq μ (fun x a => (A x).effect a) B ψ ≤ δ)
   231	    (s : Finset α) :
   232	    opDistSq μ (fun x => ∑ a ∈ s, (A x).effect a)

   234	  classical
   235	  apply le_trans ?_ h

   248	        ∑ a ∈ s, (A x).effect a * D a := by
   249	    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   250	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   251	    intro a _
   252	    simp only [D, mul_sub]

   256	    (fun a => (A x).effect a) D (hA x) horth s ψ
   257

    69	theorem questionwiseNaimark {QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB : Type*}
    70	    {ι : Type*}
    71	    [Fintype QuestionA] [DecidableEq QuestionA]
    72	    [Fintype OutcomeA] [DecidableEq OutcomeA]
    73	    [Fintype QuestionB] [DecidableEq QuestionB]
    74	    [Fintype OutcomeB] [DecidableEq OutcomeB]
    75	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    76	    (ψ : QuantumState ι)
    77	    (A : IdxSubMeas QuestionA OutcomeA ι)
    78	    (B : IdxSubMeas QuestionB OutcomeB ι) :
    79	    ∃ data : NaimarkData QuestionA OutcomeA QuestionB OutcomeB ι,

   108	    [Fintype Outcome] [DecidableEq Outcome] :
   109	    FiniteHilbertSpace.{u} where
   110	  carrier := Option Outcome

   249	      (∑ x : HA.carrier,
   250	        ∑ x_1 : HB.carrier,
   251	          ∑ x_2 : HA.carrier,

   309	/-- Conjugation by an isometry preserves contractions. -/
   310	theorem conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry {ι ι' : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   311	    [Fintype ι'] [DecidableEq ι']
   312	    (φ : EuclideanSpace ℂ ι →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ ι') {A : Op ι} (hA : Aᴴ * A ≤ 1) :
   313	    (conjIsometry φ A)ᴴ * conjIsometry φ A ≤ 1 := by
   314	  rw [conjIsometry_eq]
   315	  have h1 : (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ)ᴴ *
   316	      (isometryMatrix φ * A * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ) =
   317	      isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ := by
   318	    simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.conjTranspose_conjTranspose,
   319	      Matrix.mul_assoc]
   320	    rw [← Matrix.mul_assoc (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ (isometryMatrix φ),
   321	      isometryMatrix_conjTranspose_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   322	  rw [h1]
   323	  calc isometryMatrix φ * (Aᴴ * A) * (isometryMatrix φ)ᴴ ≤

   326	        have h := (Matrix.le_iff.mp hA).mul_mul_conjTranspose_same (isometryMatrix φ)

   330	    _ ≤ 1 := isometryMatrix_mul_conjTranspose_le_one φ

   426	/-! ## The ground projection -/
   427	
   428	/-- The orthogonal projection of an enlarged local space onto its ground slice,
   429	namely the inflation of the identity.  Formalization-only support for the
   430	transfer step of `thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   431	def groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   432	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : Op (ι × Option α) :=
   433	  naimarkInflation (α := α) (1 : Op ι)
   434	
   435	/-- Inflation is multiplicative. -/
   436	theorem naimarkInflation_mul {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   437	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M N : Op ι) :
   438	    naimarkInflation (α := α) M * naimarkInflation (α := α) N =
   439	      naimarkInflation (α := α) (M * N) := by
   440	  ext p q
   441	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
   442	    Fintype.sum_option]
   443	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]
   444	
   445	/-- Inflation commutes with the conjugate transpose. -/
   446	theorem naimarkInflation_conjTranspose {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   447	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (M : Op ι) :
   448	    (naimarkInflation (α := α) M)ᴴ = naimarkInflation (α := α) Mᴴ := by
   449	  ext p q
   450	  simp only [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, naimarkInflation_apply]
   451	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]

   453	/-- The ground projection is an orthogonal projection. -/
   454	theorem isProj_groundProjection (ι α : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   455	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] : IsProj (groundProjection ι α) := by

456	  constructor
   457	  · change groundProjection ι α * groundProjection ι α = groundProjection ι α
   458	    rw [groundProjection, naimarkInflation_mul, Matrix.mul_one]
   459	  · change star (groundProjection ι α) = groundProjection ι α
   460	    rw [Matrix.star_eq_conjTranspose, groundProjection, naimarkInflation_conjTranspose,
   461	      Matrix.conjTranspose_one]

   463	/-- Inflating the compression of an operator to the ground slice is compressing
   464	it by the ground projection. -/
   465	theorem naimarkInflation_naimarkCompression {ι α : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
   466	    [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (P : Op (ι × Option α)) :
   467	    naimarkInflation (α := α) (naimarkCompression (α := α) P) =
   468	      groundProjection ι α * P * groundProjection ι α := by
   469	  ext p q
   470	  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, naimarkInflation_apply, naimarkCompression_apply,
   471	    groundProjection, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_option, Matrix.one_apply]
   472	  by_cases hp : p.2 = none <;> by_cases hq : q.2 = none <;> simp [hp, hq]

   474	/-- Compression to the ground slice commutes with finite sums. -/

   477	    naimarkCompression (α := α) (∑ b ∈ s, M b) =

   482	/-- The dilated state lies in the ground slice on Alice's side. -/
   483	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   484	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   485	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   491	    rw [groundProjection, groundProjection, applyOperatorToState_heteroKron_naimarkInflation,
   492	      heteroKron_one_one, applyOperatorToState_one]

   495	    (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).isIdempotentElem.eq, Matrix.one_mul]
   496	  exact hfull

   514	/-- The complement of the ground slice annihilates the dilated state on Alice's
   515	side. -/
   516	theorem applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   517	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   518	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :

   521	  have h : heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) =

   523	    rw [heteroKron_sub_left, heteroKron_one_one]
   524	  have hsub : applyOperatorToState (1 - heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   525	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   526	      applyOperatorToState 1 (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   527	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (groundProjection ιA α) 1)
   528	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   529	    simp [applyOperatorToState]

   533	/-- The complement of the ground slice annihilates the dilated state on Bob's
   534	side. -/
   535	theorem applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   536	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   537	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB)) :
   538	    applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α))
   539	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) = 0 := by

   541	      1 - heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α) := by
   542	    rw [heteroKron_sub_right, heteroKron_one_one]
   543	  have hsub : applyOperatorToState (1 - heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α))
   544	      (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) =
   545	      applyOperatorToState 1 (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) -
   546	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 (groundProjection ιB α))
   547	          (naimarkDilatedState α ψ) := by
   548	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   549	  rw [h, hsub, applyOperatorToState_one, applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_groundProjection,

   552	/-! ## Leakage out of the ground slice is bounded by the intertwining defect -/
   553	
   554	/-- The leakage of a left-placed operator `P` out of the ground slice on the
   555	dilated state is at most the intertwining defect of `P ⊗ 1` against any
   556	right-placed operator `1 ⊗ Q`, because `(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.
   557	This is the estimate replacing the `≈_δ` preservation that Naimark dilation
   558	lacks (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`). -/
   559	theorem norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   560	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   561	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   562	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   563	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1)
   564	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   565	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   566	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   567	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   568	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   569	    heteroKron (1 - groundProjection ιA α) 1
   570	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   571	    applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   572	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   573	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor
   574	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιA α).one_sub)
   575	  have hsplit : heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P)
   576	      (1 : Op (ιB × Option α)) = L * heteroKron P 1 := by
   577	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   578	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron 1 Q = heteroKron 1 Q * L := by
   579	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   580	      Matrix.mul_one]
   581	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron ((1 - groundProjection ιA α) * P) 1) ψ' =
   582	      applyOperatorToState L
   583	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ') := by
   584	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   585	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' =
   586	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' +
   587	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' := by
   588	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   589	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron 1 Q), hcomm,
   590	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   591	  rw [key]
   592	  exact norm_applyOperatorToState_le hLcontr _
   593	
   594	/-- The leakage of a right-placed operator `Q` out of the ground slice on the
   595	dilated state is at most its intertwining defect against any left-placed
   596	operator. -/
   597	theorem norm_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le (α : Type) [Fintype α]
   598	    [DecidableEq α] {ιA ιB : Type} [Fintype ιA] [DecidableEq ιA] [Fintype ιB]
   599	    [DecidableEq ιB] (ψ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (ιA × ιB))
   600	    (P : Op (ιA × Option α)) (Q : Op (ιB × Option α)) :
   601	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q))
   602	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ ≤
   603	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q)
   604	        (naimarkDilatedState α ψ)‖ := by
   605	  set ψ' := naimarkDilatedState α ψ
   606	  set L : Op ((ιA × Option α) × (ιB × Option α)) :=
   607	    heteroKron 1 (1 - groundProjection ιB α)
   608	  have hL0 : applyOperatorToState L ψ' = 0 :=
   609	    applyOperatorToState_rightTensor_one_sub_groundProjection α ψ
   610	  have hLcontr : Lᴴ * L ≤ 1 :=
   611	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_rightTensor
   612	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection ιB α).one_sub)
   613	  have hsplit : heteroKron (1 : Op (ιA × Option α))
   614	      ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q) = L * heteroKron 1 Q := by
   615	    rw [heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul]
   616	  have hcomm : L * heteroKron P 1 = heteroKron P 1 * L := by
   617	    rw [heteroKron_mul, heteroKron_mul, Matrix.one_mul, Matrix.mul_one, Matrix.one_mul,
   618	      Matrix.mul_one]
   619	  have key : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 ((1 - groundProjection ιB α) * Q)) ψ' =
   620	      applyOperatorToState L
   621	        (applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ') := by
   622	    rw [hsplit, applyOperatorToState_mul]
   623	    have hdec : applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   624	        applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' +
   625	          applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   626	      simp [applyOperatorToState]
   627	    rw [hdec, applyOperatorToState_add, ← applyOperatorToState_mul L (heteroKron P 1), hcomm,
   628	      applyOperatorToState_mul, hL0, applyOperatorToState_zero, add_zero]
   629	  have hneg : -applyOperatorToState (heteroKron P 1 - heteroKron 1 Q) ψ' =
   630	      applyOperatorToState (heteroKron 1 Q - heteroKron P 1) ψ' := by
   631	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   632	  rw [key]
   633	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState L

     3	/-!
     4	# Transfer of rigidity bounds along the projective dilation
     5	
     6	The self-testing argument behind `thm:ms-rigidity` is carried out for the
     7	projective dilation `msDilatedStrategy S` of an arbitrary Magic Square strategy
     8	`S`.  Its conclusions are state-dependent bounds for the *dilated* projectors,
     9	conjugated by local isometries `φ_A`, `φ_B` out of the enlarged local spaces.
    10	The witness for the original strategy is obtained by composing these isometries
    11	with the ground embeddings, and the operators appearing in its bounds are the
    12	conjugates of the *original* effects, that is, of the compressions `Π P Π` of
    13	the dilated projectors `P` to the ground slice (`Π` the ground projection).
    14	
    15	Naimark dilation preserves Born probabilities but not state-dependent `≈_δ`
    16	estimates in general (`references/ldt-paper/orthonormalization.tex:82-101`,
    17	blueprint `ch04_projective.tex:255-270`), so `Π P Π` and `P` need not act
    18	alike on the dilated state.  Their difference on the dilated state `ψ'` is the
    19	*leakage* `(1 - Π) P ψ'` of `P` out of the ground slice, and the point of this
    20	file is that in the Magic Square game this leakage is controlled by the
    21	cell-consistency defect of the value-to-parity layer: the dilated effect
    22	`P ⊗ 1` almost agrees with the partner effect `1 ⊗ Q` on the other side, and
    23	`(1 - Π) ⊗ 1` annihilates `1 ⊗ Q ψ'`.  Combined with the closeness of
    24	`(φ_A ⊗ φ_B) ψ'` to the ideal state and the fact that all operators involved
    25	are contractions, this pulls every bound of `thm:ms-rigidity` back from the
    26	dilated strategy to the original one with explicit constants.
    27	
    28	## Main statements
    29	
    30	* `ms_effect_transfer_A`, `ms_effect_transfer_B`: the bit-measurement distances
    31	  of the original strategy are bounded by three times those of the dilated
    32	  strategy plus `216 ε + 24 η²`, where `η` bounds the state closeness.
    33	* `ms_anticommutator_transfer_A`, `ms_anticommutator_transfer_B`: the
    34	  anticommutator defects transfer with the bound `3 · (dilated) + 15552 ε +
    35	  48 η²`.
    36	* `ms_state_transfer`: the state closeness is unchanged.
    37	
    38	## References
    39	
    40	`thm:ms-rigidity`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`,
    41	paper `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`.
    42	-/
    43

    55	/-- The Born overlap of Alice's totalized variable bit with Bob's totalized
    56	constraint bit, summed over the bit, is the complement of the reverse
    57	cell-mismatch mass. -/
    58	theorem sum_stateQForm_reverse_eq (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :
    59	    ∑ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    60	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    61	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    62	      1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k := by
    63	  classical
    64	  have hterm : ∀ b : ZMod 2, stateQForm S.ψ (heteroKron
    65	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)
    66	        (((S.B (.constraint i)).postprocess (constraintBitOrZero k)).effect b)) =
    67	      ∑ a : msGame.AnswerA, ∑ c : msGame.AnswerB,
    68	        if msBitOrZero a = b then
    69	          (if constraintBitOrZero k c = b then
    70	            outcomeWeight S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i) a c else 0)
    71	        else 0 := by
    72	    intro b
    73	    rw [MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    74	      MIPStarRE.Quantum.Measurement.postprocess_effect,
    75	      heteroKron_finset_sum_left, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    76	    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    77	    split_ifs
    78	    · rw [heteroKron_finset_sum_right, stateQForm_finset_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    79	      rfl
    80	    · simp
    81	  have htotal := outcomeWeight_sum_eq_one S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) (.constraint i)
    82	  unfold reverseCellMismatchMass outcomeEventWeight
    83	  simp_rw [hterm]
    84	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← htotal, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    85	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    86	  rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    87	  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    88	  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq]
    89	  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    90	  by_cases h : msBitOrZero a = constraintBitOrZero k c
    91	  · simp [h]
    92	  · simp [h, Ne.symm h]

   147	/-- Alice's dilated variable bit approximately intertwines with Bob's dilated
   148	constraint bit: the summed squared defect is at most twice the reverse

   150	`fact:agreement` (blueprint `ch12_qpbt_games.tex:245-254`) applied to the

   152	theorem sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse (S : Strategy msGame) (i : Fin 6) (k : Fin 3) :

   154	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
   155	          heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))

   166	        (rightPlacedMeasurement (ιA := S'.ιA) QB).effect a) =

   178	      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ ^ 2 ≤
   179	      2 * (1 ^ 2 - (1 - reverseCellMismatchMass S i k)) := h1

   327	theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   328	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   329	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   330	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)

   333	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   334	        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
   335	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
   336	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   337	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   338	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   339	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   340	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
   341	  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
   342	  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   343	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   344	  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   345	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=

   445	theorem sq_le_three_mul_of_le {w x y z : ℝ} (hw : 0 ≤ w) (h : w ≤ x + y + z) :

   447	  have h1 : w ^ 2 ≤ (x + y + z) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hw h 2

   451	theorem sum_sq_le_of_le (d ℓ o : ZMod 2 → ℝ) (η ε m : ℝ)

   453	    (hL : ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 ≤ 2 * m) (hm : m ≤ 36 * ε) :

   457	  calc ∑ b, o b ^ 2 ≤ ∑ b, (3 * d b ^ 2 + 3 * ℓ b ^ 2 + 3 * (2 * η) ^ 2) :=
   458	        Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ => hterm b
   459	    _ = 3 * ∑ b, d b ^ 2 + 3 * ∑ b, ℓ b ^ 2 + 24 * η ^ 2 := by

   461	          ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card, nsmul_eq_mul]
   462	        push_cast
   463	        ring

   466	/-- Transfer of Alice's bit-measurement estimate of `thm:ms-rigidity` from the
   467	dilated strategy to the original one.  For every target family `I` and target

   470	`216 ε` from the cell-consistency masses of a strategy of value `1 - ε`, plus
   471	`24 η²` where `η` bounds the distance of the transported dilated state from
   472	`ξ`.  The isometry of the original strategy is the composite of the dilation
   473	embedding and `φ_A`, exactly as in the witness of `exists_ms_rigidity`; the
   474	left-hand side is `msOperatorDistanceA S w j W` for that witness, and the
   475	distance on the right is `msOperatorDistanceA (msDilatedStrategy S) w' j W`.

   477	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:612-652`. -/

   484	    (hξ : ‖isometryTensor φA φB (msDilatedStrategy S).ψ - ξ‖ ≤ η) :

   486	        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   487	          (((S.A (.var j)).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1)
   488	        (fun _ b => I b) ξ ≤
   489	      3 * opFamilyDistSq (uniformDistribution Unit)
   490	        (fun _ b => heteroKron (conjIsometry φA

   493	  obtain ⟨i, k, rfl⟩ := every_variable_is_incident j

   502	      (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S (.var (msConstraintVars i k)) msBitOrZero b) 1 -
   503	        heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S (.constraint i) (constraintBitOrZero k) b))
   504	      (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖)
   505	    (fun b => ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron
   506	      (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   507	        (((S.A (.var (msConstraintVars i k))).postprocess msBitOrZero).effect b)) 1 - I b) ξ‖)

   938	    3 * ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1 *
   939	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 -
   940	      -(heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1 *
   941	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)) ξ‖ ^ 2 +
   942	    15552 * ε + 48 * η ^ 2
   943	  have hXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 0)
   944	  have hZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsA S (.var 4)
   945	  have hYXc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)
   946	  have hYZc := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)
   947	  -- leakage and intertwining of the two observables
   948	  have hleakX := norm_leak_obs_le_A S i0 k0
   949	  have hintX := norm_intertwine_obs_le_A S i0 k0
   950	  have hleakZ := norm_leak_obs_le_A S i4 k4
   951	  have hintZ := norm_intertwine_obs_le_A S i4 k4
   952	  have hsqX := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i0 k0)
   953	    (reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i0 k0)
   954	  have hsqZ := sq_add_le_of_sum_sq_le _ _ ε (sum_norm_sq_intertwining_le_reverse S i4 k4)
   955	    (reverse_cell_mismatch_mass_le S ε hwin i4 k4)
   956	  rw [h0] at hleakX hintX hsqX
   957	  rw [h4] at hleakZ hintZ hsqZ

   959	  have hXZ := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))
   960	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 4)) hXc hZc
   961	  have hZX := norm_product_transfer_le_A S φA φB ξ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))
   962	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 0)) hZc hXc
   963	  have hdXZ := norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))
   964	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 4)) (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i4) (constraintBitOrZero k4)) hXc hYZc
   965	  have hdZX := norm_leftTensor_compressed_product_sub_le MsAnswer S.ψ (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))
   966	    (dilatedObsA S (.var 0)) (dilatedObsB S (.constraint i0) (constraintBitOrZero k0)) hZc hYXc
   967	  -- the anticommutator on the target state
   968	  have hsplit : ∀ (Xo Zo Xd Zd : Op (κA × κB)),
   969	      applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - -(Zo * Xo)) ξ =
   970	        applyOperatorToState (Xd * Zd - -(Zd * Xd)) ξ +
   971	          applyOperatorToState (Xo * Zo - Xd * Zd) ξ +
   972	          applyOperatorToState (Zo * Xo - Zd * Xd) ξ := by
   973	    intro Xo Zo Xd Zd
   974	    rw [← applyOperatorToState_add_op, ← applyOperatorToState_add_op]
   975	    congr 1
   976	    abel
   977	  rw [hsplit _ _ (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 0))) 1)
   978	    (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedObsA S (.var 4))) 1)]

   980	  refine le_trans (norm_add_le _ _) (le_trans (add_le_add_left (norm_add_le _ _) _) ?_)
   981	  linarith [hXZ, hZX, hdXZ, hdZX, hleakX, hintX, hleakZ, hintZ, hξ']

   321	/-- Per-outcome transfer estimate on Alice's side.  For any target operator `T`,
   322	the distance of the conjugated original effect from `T` on the target state
   323	`ξ` is at most the distance of the conjugated dilated effect from `T`, plus the
   324	intertwining defect of the dilated effect against Bob's partner effect `Q` on
   325	the dilated state, plus twice the distance from `ξ` to the transported dilated
   326	state.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:224-253`. -/
   327	theorem norm_effect_transfer_term_le_A {κA κB : Type} [Fintype κA] [DecidableEq κA]
   328	    [Fintype κB] [DecidableEq κB] (S : Strategy msGame)
   329	    (φA : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιA × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κA)
   330	    (φB : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.ιB × Option MsAnswer) →ₗᵢ[ℂ] EuclideanSpace ℂ κB)
   331	    (ξ : EuclideanSpace ℂ (κA × κB)) (T : Op (κA × κB)) (x y : MsType)
   332	    (f g : MsAnswer → ZMod 2) (b : ZMod 2) :
   333	    ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry (φA.comp (naimarkEmbedding S.ιA MsAnswer))
   334	        (((S.A x).postprocess f).effect b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ ≤
   335	      ‖applyOperatorToState (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 - T) ξ‖ +
   336	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   337	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   338	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ +
   339	      2 * ‖isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) - ξ‖ := by
   340	  rw [conjIsometry_comp_naimarkEmbedding, naimarkInflation_postprocess_A]
   341	  have hP := conjTranspose_mul_le_one_dilatedEffectA S x f b
   342	  have hG : (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)ᴴ * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer ≤ 1 :=
   343	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_of_isProj (isProj_groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)
   344	  have hAd : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   345	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   346	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA hP)
   347	  have hAo : (heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   348	      dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) (1 : Op κB))ᴴ *
   349	      heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   350	        dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 ≤ 1 :=
   351	    conjTranspose_mul_le_one_leftTensor (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_conjIsometry φA
   352	      (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul (conjTranspose_mul_le_one_mul hG hP) hG))
   353	  set Ao : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer *
   354	    dilatedEffectA S x f b * groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 with hAo_def
   355	  set Ad : Op (κA × κB) := heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b)) 1 with hAd_def
   356	  set ψ'' := isometryTensor φA φB (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ) with hψ''
   357	  have h1 : applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ =
   358	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ := by
   359	    simp [applyOperatorToState]
   360	  have h2 : applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ =
   361	      applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'' - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ) := by
   362	    rw [applyOperatorToState_sub, sub_sub_cancel]
   363	  have h3 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ''‖ ≤
   364	      ‖applyOperatorToState
   365	        (heteroKron (dilatedEffectA S x f b) 1 - heteroKron 1 (dilatedEffectB S y g b))
   366	        (naimarkDilatedState MsAnswer S.ψ)‖ := by
   367	    have hdiff : Ad - Ao = heteroKron (conjIsometry φA (dilatedEffectA S x f b -
   368	        groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer * dilatedEffectA S x f b *
   369	          groundProjection S.ιA MsAnswer)) 1 := by
   370	      rw [hAd_def, hAo_def, conjIsometry_sub, heteroKron_sub_left]
   371	    rw [hdiff, hψ'', applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_conjIsometry, norm_isometryTensor,
   372	      applyOperatorToState_leftTensor_sub_compression]
   373	    exact norm_leftTensor_one_sub_groundProjection_mul_le MsAnswer S.ψ _ _
   374	  have h4 : ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)‖ ≤ 2 * ‖ψ'' - ξ‖ :=
   375	    norm_applyOperatorToState_sub_le hAd hAo _
   376	  calc ‖applyOperatorToState (Ao - T) ξ‖ =
   377	        ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ - applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ := by rw [h1]
   378	    _ ≤ ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - T) ξ‖ + ‖applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ξ‖ :=
   379	        norm_sub_le _ _
   380	    _ ≤ _ := by
   381	        rw [h2]
   382	        linarith [norm_sub_le (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) ψ'')
   383	          (applyOperatorToState (Ad - Ao) (ψ'' - ξ)), h3, h4]
